blocks.text: The contracts management system flags contracts for renewal 90 days before their expiration date. The business owner receives a renewal notification and initiates the review process.

Renewals valued under $100,000 require approval from the business owner only. Renewals between $100,000 and $1,000,000 require Finance approval. Renewals exceeding $1,000,000 require Legal and Finance to conduct parallel reviews, followed by CFO approval.
Any contract containing non-standard terms requires a Legal review regardless of the contract value.
The CFO must approve all renewals exceeding $1,000,000 after Legal and Finance have both completed their reviews.

messages.text: Reminder: as of Q1, the threshold for requiring parallel Legal and Finance review has been lowered to $750,000. Any renewal over $750K now follows the high-value process.
